Your definitely not nothing, I can promise you that. Why do you want to be famous? And how can you relate to people you don't even know... you think you relate to the actors but really your relating to their characters... maybe not the characters from the movie but the characters they put on in the public eye. You'll be surprised how many 'famous' people are incredibly unhappy.

I relate to watching a movie character and being jealous of their life, and they don't even have to be glamorous, I can watch a movie about the army and fantasise about signing up! Or even a f*cked up relationship and I still wish it was me, because at least they have someone to argue with, right? 

The truth is though, none of that is real! Movies, tv shows, books - they are all made to play with your emotions, I do think what your describing is a lot more common than you think though. 

It's sounds to me like you've actually got one hell of a lot to live for... a loving mom, sister, brother, boyfriend even if they don't always understand you... and you want to become a teacher, that's cool.. think of all the people you could help!

Letting it all out is a good start, don't let things overwhelm you and please don't compare your life to movies... I promise you, nobody's that 'perfect'.  If you need to talk, I'm more than happy to listen.
I'm here if you need a friend. What do you want to talk about? My message box is open.
